name: An Encounter
source:
"This must be how ghosts feel...."

Van was a girl that had nearly given up on life, wishing for the rain to take her. That is, until she met a kind girl offering her umbrella, as well as her friendship.

[Edited from [url=https://tofu-sheets-visual.itch.io/an-encounter-original-ver]Itch.io[/url]]

The original, unfinished version of [url=/v33975]An Encounter ~In The Rain~[/url]
translation:
“幽灵一定就是这种感觉吧……”

Van几乎已经放弃了生活，只盼大雨能将自己带走。直到她遇见一位善良的女孩，对方向她递出了雨伞，也递出了友谊。
